Durand Cup Football Matches Feature Multiple Victories and Hat-tricks

The Durand Cup football tournament saw several matches played. FC Raengdai defeated TRAU FC 4-3, with Mridul Doley scoring a hat-trick for Raengdai, propelling them to the top of Group D. In another match, Mohun Bagan Super Giant beat South United FC 8-0, with Manvir scoring a hat-trick. Sporting Club Delhi came from behind to defeat Jamshedpur FC 2-1. FC1 also secured a 2-1 victory over Karbi Anglong Morning Star on their Durand Cup debut, despite playing with 10 men.
